data.name: Aushim
data.gender_notes: Aushim is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Aushadh', meaning 'healing or cure'. The name Aushim is often given to a child born during a time of great prosperity and good fortune. The name Aushim carries the meaning “Auspicious, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aushim usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of hope, healing, and positive change.
data.etymology: Aushim belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Auspicious, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aushim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
